$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the services-emergency pack composed with an HVAC content seed and a steel-teal brand over the sitework register. Everything else — pages, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Heating & cooling (HVAC)
description: A heating-and-cooling site built for the no-heat call: a phone number that never leaves the viewport, flat printed prices, response-time proof, a four-step dispatch story, and a callback form for tune-ups and installs — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

theme.$comment: Steel teal over the sitework register's plan-grid ground — the dispatch shape's utility-blue plumber recolored to the mechanical trade's cool voice. mode dark opens the site on the register's night shift (floodlit-yard ground, bone type, the teal luminous against the asphalt — the furnace-out-at-midnight call; the appearance toggle still swaps to the daylight sheet). Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-skins the pages and the app surfaces together.
